# Flygon Flow

> Flygon Flow keeps a MindMap (people, entities and ideas; called charts in the API), a product timeline, a DevOps board and AgentFlow (agents and workflows) in one workspace per environment. People use the web app. Agents use the same operations through the REST API, the MCP server or the CLI, authenticated with a personal API key (`flow_…`).

Version 0.11.23 (2026-11-02). Base URL: your Flow server. Auth: `Authorization: Bearer flow_…`. OpenAPI: /api/v1/openapi.json.

## Concepts

- [Environments](/docs/index.html#environments): An **environment** is one workspace: its charts, projects, timeline and DevOps board, plus a record of who owns it.
- [MindMap (charts)](/docs/index.html#mindmap-charts): The app's **MindMap** tab is a free-form canvas of **cards** joined by **edges**.
- [Timeline](/docs/index.html#timeline): The timeline holds dated **items** that are tagged with **projects**.
- [DevOps board and gates](/docs/index.html#devops-board-and-gates): The DevOps board is a card board.
- [Agent inbox](/docs/index.html#agent-inbox): Agents can add or update projects, labels, timeline items and cards by dropping a JSON **patch** into the inbox.
- [Sync](/docs/index.html#sync): The server is the source of truth.
- [Sharing](/docs/index.html#sharing): The owner of an environment can share part of it with another Flow user, by email: a person and everything below them, hand-picked cards, a project, a DevOps label, or the whole environment.
- [Versioning](/docs/index.html#versioning): Flygon Flow uses [Bradshaw Versioning](https://github.com/aribradshaw/devlog/blob/main/docs/bradshaw-versioning.md).
- [AgentFlow](/docs/index.html#agentflow): AgentFlow is an org chart for agentic work.

## API: Environments

- [envs.list](/docs/envs.html#op-envs-list): `GET /api/v1/envs` (read). List environments
- [envs.get](/docs/envs.html#op-envs-get): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}` (read). Get an environment

## API: MindMap charts

- [charts.list](/docs/charts.html#op-charts-list): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts` (read). List charts

## API: Nodes

- [nodes.list](/docs/nodes.html#op-nodes-list): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/nodes` (read). List nodes
- [nodes.get](/docs/nodes.html#op-nodes-get): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/nodes/{node}` (read). Get a node
- [nodes.create](/docs/nodes.html#op-nodes-create): `POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/nodes` (write). Create a node
- [nodes.update](/docs/nodes.html#op-nodes-update): `PATCH /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/nodes/{node}` (write). Update a node
- [nodes.move](/docs/nodes.html#op-nodes-move): `POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/nodes/{node}/move` (write). Move a node

## API: Edges

- [edges.list](/docs/edges.html#op-edges-list): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/edges` (read). List edges
- [edges.create](/docs/edges.html#op-edges-create): `POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/edges` (write). Create an edge
- [edges.delete](/docs/edges.html#op-edges-delete): `DELETE /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/edges/{edge}` (write). Delete an edge

## API: Projects

- [projects.list](/docs/projects.html#op-projects-list): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/projects` (read). List projects
- [projects.create](/docs/projects.html#op-projects-create): `POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/projects` (write). Create a project
- [projects.update](/docs/projects.html#op-projects-update): `PATCH /api/v1/envs/{env}/projects/{project}` (write). Update a project

## API: Timeline

- [items.list](/docs/timeline.html#op-items-list): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/items` (read). List timeline items
- [items.get](/docs/timeline.html#op-items-get): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/items/{item}` (read). Get a timeline item
- [items.create](/docs/timeline.html#op-items-create): `POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/items` (write). Create a timeline item
- [items.update](/docs/timeline.html#op-items-update): `PATCH /api/v1/envs/{env}/items/{item}` (write). Update a timeline item

## API: DevOps cards

- [cards.list](/docs/cards.html#op-cards-list): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/cards` (read). List DevOps cards
- [cards.get](/docs/cards.html#op-cards-get): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/cards/{card}` (read). Get a DevOps card
- [cards.create](/docs/cards.html#op-cards-create): `POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/cards` (write). Create a DevOps card
- [cards.update](/docs/cards.html#op-cards-update): `PATCH /api/v1/envs/{env}/cards/{card}` (write). Update a DevOps card
- [cards.move](/docs/cards.html#op-cards-move): `POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/cards/{card}/move` (write). Move a DevOps card

## API: Labels

- [labels.list](/docs/labels.html#op-labels-list): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/labels` (read). List DevOps labels
- [labels.create](/docs/labels.html#op-labels-create): `POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/labels` (write). Create a DevOps label

## API: AgentFlow agents

- [agents.list](/docs/agents.html#op-agents-list): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents` (read). List AgentFlow agents
- [agents.get](/docs/agents.html#op-agents-get): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents/{agent}` (read). Get an AgentFlow agent and its brief
- [agents.work](/docs/agents.html#op-agents-work): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents/{agent}/work` (read). Get an agent's work queue
- [agents.create](/docs/agents.html#op-agents-create): `POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents` (write). Create an AgentFlow agent
- [agents.update](/docs/agents.html#op-agents-update): `PATCH /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents/{agent}` (write). Update an AgentFlow agent
- [agents.delete](/docs/agents.html#op-agents-delete): `DELETE /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents/{agent}` (write). Delete an AgentFlow agent
- [runners.list](/docs/agents.html#op-runners-list): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/runners` (read). List AgentFlow runners
- [runners.report](/docs/agents.html#op-runners-report): `POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/runners/{runner}` (write). Report a runner and its models

## API: AgentFlow workflows

- [workflows.list](/docs/workflows.html#op-workflows-list): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/workflows` (read). List AgentFlow workflows
- [workflows.get](/docs/workflows.html#op-workflows-get): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/workflows/{workflow}` (read). Get an AgentFlow workflow and its brief
- [workflows.create](/docs/workflows.html#op-workflows-create): `POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/workflows` (write). Create an AgentFlow workflow
- [workflows.update](/docs/workflows.html#op-workflows-update): `PATCH /api/v1/envs/{env}/workflows/{workflow}` (write). Update an AgentFlow workflow

## API: Search

- [search](/docs/search.html#op-search): `GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/search` (read). Search an environment
